releases.notes:
## What's changed
- Disable glowing for paperdoll. Fix [#69](https://github.com/tr7zw/PaperDoll/issues/69)
- Fix elytra behavior in later versions
- Add option to show paperdoll during f3 text rendering. Fix [#70](https://github.com/tr7zw/PaperDoll/issues/70)
- Add setting that by default hides the paperdoll during the music toast for 26.1+. Fix [#65](https://github.com/tr7zw/PaperDoll/issues/65)
- Add option to hide while any screen is open. Fix [#64](https://github.com/tr7zw/PaperDoll/issues/64)
- Make canvas bigger so nametags are visible with Essential
- Optimize icon size
- Cleanup/Refactor render logic

**Full Changelog**: https://github.com/tr7zw/PaperDoll/compare/1.5.0.2...1.5.1

releases.notes:
Sorry for the really delayed release. The Picture in Picture renderer that Minecraft provides for rendering Entities in the UI did not allow the vehicle render feature that this mod provides. I had to find the time to get a bit creative to work around this issue, but they are now fully working in 26.1/26.2. (.2 release due to publishing issues to Modrinth due to PAT issues)

## What's Changed
* Added 26.2 support
* Added 26.1 support
* Fixed missing category name in the controls list

**Full Changelog**: https://github.com/tr7zw/PaperDoll/compare/1.4.0...1.5.0.2
